name: 168 Crab & Karaoke
description: 168 Crab & Karaoke is a vibrant venue that combines delicious seafood with an energetic karaoke experience. It offers private rooms suitable for various party sizes, creating an intimate and fun atmosphere. The place is known for its excellent food, strong drinks, and lively environment, making it a perfect spot for celebrations, private events, or just a fun night out with friends and family. The staff is friendly and attentive, ensuring a memorable experience from start to finish.
